title: Disconnectedness of the Hilbert Schemes of $E_6/P_6$
summary: In this note, we show that the Hilbert scheme $\text{Hilb}_{P_{d,4}(t)}(E_6/P_6)$ associated with the Hilbert polynomial $P_{d,4}(t)$ is disconnected by determining that it has exactly two connected components. This result adapts Seong's methods, successfully extending the disconnectedness of Grassmannians to the exceptional type $E_6$.
